plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for InHand Networks industrial cellular routers (PEN 36153, INHAND-WAN3G-MIB). Besides standard IF-MIB 64-bit interface traffic, it collects cellular modem temperature, modem state, cellular connection status and the signal level indicator.
name: Router

metrics.name: device_modem_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Cellular modem temperature of the InHand industrial router in degrees Celsius from INHAND-WAN3G-MIB ih3gModemTemperature (Integer32 −50..100). Values outside that range are dropped.

metrics.name: device_modem_state
metrics.description: Cellular modem operational state from INHAND-WAN3G-MIB ih3gModemState, normalised to 1=normal (up) / 2=abnormal (down or unknown).

metrics.name: device_cellular_connected
metrics.description: Cellular connection status from INHAND-WAN3G-MIB ih3gConnectionStatus, normalised to 1=normal (connected) / 2=abnormal (unknown and 2..10).

metrics.name: device_cellular_signal_level
metrics.description: Cellular signal LED level from INHAND-WAN3G-MIB ih3gSignalLevel (raw integer indicator, not a dBm reading). Values below 0 or above 100 are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
